releases.notes:
## Changelog

### Changed
-  `adventure-platform-mod` is no longer bundled inside of the `mods-command` jar, instead users should download it from [Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/adventure-platform-mod) as a separate library mod. This may allow `mods-command` to run on newer versions without an update so long as `adventure-platform-mod` is updated, but this is not always the case.
